## Three-Way Match Panel ⭐

What we ORDERED (PO lines) vs what ARRIVED (the PO's receivedQuantities) vs what the vendor INVOICED, per line, within tolerance (±2% or $25). The match is ALWAYS re-derived from the three documents (pure functions in three-way-match.gts) — nothing derived is stored, so it can never drift; only RESOLUTIONS are stored, on the invoice, because a resolution is a human decision. Unlike the display-only siblings this is a WORKBENCH: it takes @context and runs ResolveVarianceCommand / ApproveInvoiceForPaymentCommand itself, so mounting it in the shared Invoice card needed only one additive conditional section.

### Example

The linked INV N-4471: monitors line matches 55/55 clean; a freight line the PO never carried shows as 'invoiced, not on PO' — resolve it with a reason or payment stays blocked.

### Non-goals

No OCR/ingest — invoices arrive as structured cards. No cross-currency compare inside the panel in v1 (resolve through Currency Registry first; the refusal-on-stale command exists). No payment execution — approval hands over to the existing Payment flow.
